## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] `npm run lint` from `vibeforge-ui/`
- [ ] `npm run build` from `vibeforge-ui/`
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
- [ ] No secrets or generated files are included

## Notes for reviewers

Mention tradeoffs, known limitations, migration concerns, or follow-up work.
